title: The Gingerbread House - Location & Charm
description:
Enjoy your Nashville visit in our beautifully renovated home. You’ll love our home because of its neighborhood & comfortable accommodations. There are parks, grocery stores, restaurants, coffee shops, & more in walking distance. Our home is 5 miles from heart of downtown & a quick Uber ride to Midtown, Gulch, and 12th South neighborhoods. Our home features 2 spacious bedrooms, a fully-equipped kitchen & high-speed TV and internet. Our home is great for couples, business travelers, or families.

Guest access
Guests have access to the entire home.

Other things to note
Pets are allowed on a case-by-case basis with a $100 non-refundable pet deposit.  Guests must have prior approval before bringing a pet.  Please send us a message if you have questions or would like more information.
